gap: Snowman mugs are figurals, single cartoon faces, personalized cocoa mugs or clip-art templates; none of the results was a layered watercolor all-over pattern. Our angle: a full wrap of hand-painted watercolor snowmen in knit hats, earmuffs and striped scarves with knit mittens, snowy pine, pinecones, winterberries and snowflakes on cream paper; winter, not Christmas (no Santa hats, ornaments or holly), so it sells December to February.
decision: go (21/25): pattern design 'Snowmen & Mittens' (all-over mug + accent mugs)
repeat_check: pod-kit/designs (35 designs) has no snowman design; Snowy Pine Cardinals and Foxes & Hedgehogs are winter wildlife patterns, so this one leaves out birds and animals.
